shortDescription: CyberArk Application Management using Privilege Cloud Web Shared Services REST API.

options.name: access_permitted_from
options.description: The start hour that access is permitted to the application. Valid values between 0-23

options.name: access_permitted_to
options.description: The end hour that access is permitted to the application. Valid values between 0-23

options.name: api_base_url
options.description: A string containing the base URL of the server hosting CyberArk's Privileged Account Security Web Services SDK. Example U(https://<IIS_Server_Ip>/PasswordVault/api/)

options.name: authentication
options.description: A list of authentication methods for the application. Options can include AddSafes and AuditUsers. The default provides backwards compatability with older versions of the collection.

options.name: business_owner_email
options.description: The email of the business owner.

options.name: business_owner_f_name
options.description: The first name of the business owner.

options.name: business_owner_l_name
options.description: The last name of the business owner.

options.name: business_owner_phone
options.description: The phone number of the business owner.

options.name: cyberark_session
options.description: Dictionary set by a CyberArk authentication containing the different values to perform actions on a logged-on CyberArk session, please see M(cyberark.isp.cyberark_authentication) module for an example of cyberark_session.

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the application. Specify up to 29 characters.

options.name: expiration_date
options.description: The date when the application expires. In format mm-dd-yyyy

options.name: location
options.description: The location of the application in Privilege Cloud hierarchy. To insert a backslash in the location path, use a double backslash.

options.name: logging_file
options.description: Setting the log file name and location for troubleshooting logs.

options.name: logging_level
options.description: Parameter used to define the level of troubleshooting output to the C(logging_file) value.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the state needed for the application. present to ensure application exists, absent to ensure application does not exist.

options.name: timeout
options.description: How long to wait for the server to send data before giving up

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificate chain will not be validated.  This should only set to C(true) if you have a root CA certificate installed on each node.
